subject.title: 一个现实的问题，很多人将面临无法访问github

question: Should this vague GitHub-access/VPN report be handled as off-topic promotion, or kept for a concrete ClawHub auth/network reproduction?
rationale: The issue provides no source-level reproduction and may be external promotion, while repository cleanup policy does not allow closing ClawHub issues unless current main definitely implements the requested behavior.

options.title: Close administratively as off-topic
options.body: Treat the VPN registration link and lack of ClawHub reproduction as external promotion handled by maintainers outside the source cleanup lane.

options.title: Request scoped reproduction details
options.body: Ask for the affected ClawHub command/page, exact error, version, network setup, and whether proxy variables or device login change the outcome.

options.title: Split a product/auth request
options.body: If maintainers want non-GitHub auth or regional access support, open a separate requirements-driven product issue instead of repairing this report directly.

recommendation.title: Close administratively as off-topic
recommendation.body: Treat the VPN registration link and lack of ClawHub reproduction as external promotion handled by maintainers outside the source cleanup lane.

likelyOwner.reason: Current local blame points across the auth, sign-in, and proxy surfaces that would frame any maintainer product/support decision.
